body: At 1,000 cards, alternating release runs reduce create median from 163 to 116–117 ms and p95 from 170–175 to 119–135 ms. An earlier optimized run has a 1,266 ms maximum; it remains recorded and the target is not claimed unconditionally. Scoped readers preserve all source/lease/version/durability checks, sorted results and first-error ordering, with at most four workers and one nonblocking process-wide capacity guard. The required 100-project/10k-card/50k-report profile records mixed-write p95 43 ms and indexed-query p95 20 ms; Attention/global tag catalog still cost 86 ms/1.8 s. The full/combined gate passes 255 Rust, 137 JavaScript and 12 Python tests; all 24 Chromium, five WebKit, broad HTTPS and planning checks pass. The rebuilt manual app preserves all 42 prior resource versions, pins, preferences and certificate; HTTPS and 33 assets are verified. Two further calendar prototypes show no useful latency gain and are reverted. Correction to the earlier source-path report: the performance requirement specifies 200 mixed mutations after warmup, not a separate 200-create minimum. Physical-device, transport and full release acceptance remain open. Evidence: progress/2026-09-30-parallel-source.md and progress/2026-09-30-calendar-followup.md.

metadata.summary: Verified bounded source reads improve large-collection creation; full release dataset measured.
